body:
New -poll-interval-min/-max + -poll-jitter flags, all defaulting to old exact behavior (zero change for live PRNewswire polling). Recommended real BusinessWire values named in flag help: -poll-interval-min=15s -poll-interval-max=1m -poll-jitter=10s, matching founder's exact ask ('crawl and rest between 15s and 1m +-10'). New main_test.go (previously none). go build/test clean. Commit faba940.

⚓ ☃
